# Start, the monthly and weekly ticks of Zol, and capitulation (which ends the war with white peace, never an annexation).
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			Y0U = { country_event = { id = zin_mistake.1 } }
		}
	}
	on_monthly_Y0U = {
		effect = {
			zin_zol_monthly = yes
		}
	}
	on_weekly_Y0U = {
		effect = {
			zin_zol_weekly_manifest = yes
		}
	}
	on_capitulation_immediate = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { zin_is_zol = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_cause = 1 }
				zin_zol_withdraw = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
